Normalized genomic region the record covers. POLIOVIRUS ONLY -- the upstream record_type is derived against Sabin VP1 coordinates, so no scope determination exists for non-polio EV.
missing_value_semantics: 'unknown' for every non_polio_enterovirus row (not determined) and for an unmapped polio record_type
derivation: mapped from pipeline record_type for poliovirus; 'unknown' otherwise (R-SCOPE-1)
ml_utility: stratification / region feature; usable only within the poliovirus partition

definition: NCBI Taxonomy identifier from the source feature.
ml_leakage_risk: medium: may encode the label for typed viruses
high: often contains the type/serotype label verbatim

definition: Unified canonical type: PV{1,2,3} for polio; enterovirus type for non-polio EV (name-derived, else confident sequence-derived).
missing_value_semantics: blank when neither name nor confident well-covered sequence type is available; for polio this means no coverage-guarded serotype could be resolved
derivation: R-TYPE-1; polio via the coverage-guarded build_final_carve.canonical_serotype (>=100 capsid codons, confident, VP1==capsid) shared with the v1 carve; EV precedence name -> confident enterovirus_type_sequence (basis in canonical_projection_provenance)

ml_leakage_risk: label if predicting classification; derived partly from sequence
medium: correlated with classification via surveillance context

definition: Collection date as a single point value, always ISO 8601 and always parseable: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Read WITH collection_date_precision -- when precision == 'range' this is a derived midpoint, not a measured date, and collection_year_earliest/latest carry the true bounds.
derivation: precision-driven, curated-first (R-DATE-1): day->collection_date_curated, month->source date normalized to YYYY-MM, year->collection_year_curated, range->collection_year_curated (the R-DATE-RANGE-1 midpoint)
ml_utility: temporal feature; parse directly, no interval or Mon-YYYY strings
ml_leakage_risk: medium: date strongly correlates with lineage era

missing_value_semantics: 'unknown' when precision not determinable or the date is absent; never blank for included rows
derivation: collection_date_precision (R-DATE-PRECISION-1); 'range' means collection_date is a midpoint and the bounds are in collection_year_earliest/latest

definition: Earliest possible collection year for an interval /collection_date. Populated IFF collection_date_precision == 'range'.
derivation: first endpoint year of the GenBank interval (R-DATE-RANGE-1)

definition: Latest possible collection year for an interval /collection_date. Populated IFF collection_date_precision == 'range'.
derivation: second endpoint year of the GenBank interval (R-DATE-RANGE-1)

definition: Country parsed from the GenBank geographic source (INSDC English name).

derivation: geo_loc_name after ':' before ','; locality is the finer remainder and is blank when it would merely repeat this value

definition: Sub-admin1 locality detail. Non-blank ONLY when the deposit carried text finer than admin1; it is not a duplicate of admin1 (R-GEO-LOCALITY-1). source/records keeps the as-parsed string including the admin1 echo.
missing_value_semantics: blank when the deposit gave no detail finer than admin1 (the common case: 4,285 of 5,319 admin1-bearing rows)
derivation: geo_loc_name after ':', blanked when equal to admin1
ml_utility: geographic feature; presence itself signals deposit detail
